description: Search available GPUs on the marketplace. Filter by model, price, VRAM, Ollama model name, or access type. Each result carries accessTypes — what the GPU can be rented AS: "ollama" (HTTP inference), "ssh" (a real shell on the machine) and/or "docker" (the Docker daemon). ssh/docker ride an encrypted tunnel, so no public IP or port-forward is involved.

accessType.description: Only return GPUs that offer this access type

gpu.description: GPU model filter (e.g. RTX4090, A100, H100)

maxPrice.description: Max price per hour in USD

name: gpusmarket_search
